hooks.name: RotoWire Props Snapshot (ongoing line-movement tracking)
hooks.description: Reminds the agent at session start that RotoWire prop-line snapshots should be taken repeatedly through the week (not just once) to build real line-movement history, since this is now the ongoing free source for that per the user's 2026-09-25 decision.

action.prompt:
Reminder for the frontal-lobe2 NFL data lake: RotoWire player prop lines move continuously through the week leading up to games (free, no request cap, already integrated as gold.nfl_prop_line_rotowire). Per the user's decision on 2026-09-25, this is now an ONGOING tracked source for line movement -- take a fresh snapshot regularly through the week (not just once), using:

PYTHONPATH=.pylibs python3 scripts/ingest_rotowire_props.py

Each run is append-only and safe to repeat. The is_pregame flag (fixed 2026-09-25) ensures only pre-kickoff snapshots feed gold.v_nfl_prop_line_movement -- live in-game snapshots are correctly excluded from movement analysis. If the user asks about line movement, trends, or "what changed this week," check whether a fresh snapshot is needed first (gold.v_nfl_prop_line_movement will have 0 rows if only one snapshot exists so far this week).
